cards.subject: Orcs & Humans, mission five
lines: The fifth mission of the orc campaign in the first Warcraft is called The Redridge Mountains, and its briefing spells it Red Ridge.
An orc outpost under siege, ordered to finish the human encampment. Same ground, eleven years earlier.

cards.subject: One of the last peaceful regions
lines: Rushing rivers, towering elms, and technically independent of Stormwind since the Second War, though under its protection.
It sends the capital timber, fish and crops.
That is the joke of the place: a breadbasket with an orc fortress in the east.

cards.subject: The Everstill Bridge
lines: Orcs destroyed it. Foreman Oslow has been rebuilding it since before you arrived, and he is still at it when you outlevel the zone.
"I've finished every project on-time and under budget and I'm not about to start slipping now."
It stays broken for all of vanilla.

cards.subject: Lake Everstill
lines: Lakeshire lives on the lake — the fishing, the crossing, the view. Murlocs have the shoreline.
Somewhere on the bottom is Oslow's toolbox, sunk when a catapult caught the supply boat.
The whole zone's problem, in one object.

cards.subject: Bart Rethban
lines: The ore is named for the first man to find it, and the caves are presumed named for him too.
Nothing else about him is recorded anywhere. Status unknown.
And you do not mine the ore. You take it off the gnolls living in his cave.

cards.subject: Alther's Mill
lines: The abandoned lumber mill is full of practice lockboxes — the spot Alliance rogues came to work on Pick Lock.
The orcs holding it keep a very large worg kennel, and a human prisoner named Messner.

cards.subject: Stonewatch Keep
lines: Lakeshire held the castle. Morganth — a Stormwind mage exiled for dark magic — allied with Gath'Ilzogg's Blackrock orcs to take it.
Then he betrayed the orcs too, walked out, and set up in the Tower of Ilgalar.

cards.subject: The gnolls are on a leash
lines: They are not a tribe raiding on their own account. Morganth commands them through magical pendants.
He was banished from the Mage Quarter for refusing to give up the dark arts, and he left with a sealed book: Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic.
Ur wrote the worgen warning Arugal ignored.

cards.subject: The Eye of Azora
lines: Theocritus, in the Tower of Azora back in Elwynn Forest, keeps a scrying sphere.
What it shows is the Tower of Ilgalar and the ground around it.
Two towers, two zones apart, one pointed at the other.

cards.subject: Singe
lines: The warlord in Stonewatch keeps a black dragon whelp beside him.
It is probably a gift from Victor Nefarius — payment for taking the keep.
A level twenty zone, quietly wired to Blackrock Spire.

cards.subject: Corporal Keeshan
cards.tag: Before he was an action hero
lines: In here he is a beaten prisoner in a cave at Render's Rock: "I took a strong blow to the head and everything went black... you're my last hope."
You walk him home to Marshal Marris and that is the end of him.
Everything else people remember about Keeshan was written five years later.

cards.subject: The road north
lines: Redridge is fifteen to twenty-five. The pass at its northern end opens into the Burning Steppes, fifty to fifty-eight.
It is one of the largest level gaps across any border in the game.
Just road.
